backend/main.mo: Main actor implementing user profile management, Stripe payment integration, blob storage, and access control with admin/user permission checks for profile operations and checkout sessions.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that renames the `stripeConfig` field to `configuration` when upgrading from old actor state to new actor state.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four admin features: theme management, page management, pricing settings, and payment gateway integration with associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including routing, dashboard pages, admin panels, calculators, profile management, and UI components for the Propfolio trading platform.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes defining colors for UI elements like backgrounds, borders, cards, and sidebar components.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Propfolio React application with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for landing page, dashboard pages, admin panels (theme, page management, pricing, payment gateways, payments), legal pages, and ThemeProvider wrapper.
frontend/src/components/AddAccountDialog: Dialog component for adding prop firm accounts with dropdown of 55+ firms, custom firm input option, account number and size fields, and form validation.
Dashboard layout wrapper enforcing authentication, showing login prompt for unauthenticated users, displaying profile setup modal for new users, and rendering sidebar with content outlet.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying Propfolio logo, legal links (privacy/refund policies), quick links (subscribe/affiliate), and copyright notice with caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Login/logout button component that handles Internet Identity authentication, clears query cache on logout, and displays appropriate state (logging in, login, logout).
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog for initial user profile setup requiring username, full name, email, mobile, and Discord user ID fields with form validation and submission.
frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx: Navigation sidebar with Propfolio logo, menu items for all dashboard sections (payouts, accounts, expenses, trading tools, etc.), active route highlighting, and login button at bottom.
frontend/src/constants/propFirms.ts: Exported sorted array of 60+ prop trading firm names including FTMO, Topstep, Apex Trader Funding, and others.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication, initializes access control, and invalidates dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: React Query hook to fetch current user profile data (username, email, mobile, Discord ID, social links); currently returns null to trigger profile setup flow.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and delegation validity with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: React Query mutation hook for saving user profile data that updates the query cache on success; backend implementation pending.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark theme colors (primary, secondary, muted, destructive, sidebar, etc.) using OKLCH color space.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the root component wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider for state management and authentication.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminAffiliateW: Admin page for managing affiliate withdrawal requests with placeholder content indicating functionality is coming soon. Includes navigation back to admin dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminDisputes.t: Admin page for viewing and managing user disputes with placeholder content for future implementation. Includes back navigation to admin area.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminOffers.tsx: Admin page for managing discount offers with placeholder content for adding, editing, or removing offers. Includes back navigation to admin dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminPageManage: Admin page for controlling dashboard page visibility and navigation order with toggles for 15 pages. Includes drag-and-drop indicators and save functionality.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminPanel.tsx: Main admin dashboard that displays a grid of navigation cards for all admin sections including theme settings, page management, pricing, payment gateways, prop firms, offers, reviews, disputes, products, users, subscriptions, and affiliate withdrawals.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminPaymentGat: Admin page for configuring payment gateway integrations (Stripe, Razorpay, Coinbase, NOWPayments) with API key management, enable/disable toggles, and connection testing functionality.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminPayments.t: Admin page displaying a filterable table of payment transactions with status badges, gateway information, and export options for CSV/PDF reports.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminPricingSet: Admin page for configuring subscription pricing including amount, currency, billing interval, and managing the list of subscription features with add/remove functionality.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminProducts.t: Placeholder admin page for managing shop products with a 'coming soon' message.
Placeholder admin page for managing prop firms list with a 'coming soon' message.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminReviews.ts: Placeholder admin page for moderating user reviews with a 'coming soon' message.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminSubscripti: Placeholder admin page for viewing and managing user subscriptions with a 'coming soon' message.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminThemeSetti: Admin page for customizing application theme settings including mode (light/dark), primary color, and accent color with save functionality.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminUsers.tsx: Admin user management page with placeholder content indicating functionality is coming soon.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Accounts.ts: Dashboard page for managing prop firm accounts with an add account dialog and empty state display.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Affiliate.t: Affiliate program page displaying earnings metrics (total, pending, redeemable) and a referral link with copy functionality.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Compounding: Compounding calculator page with inputs for capital, return rate, frequency, and duration that generates period-by-period growth projections in a table.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/DashboardOv: Main dashboard overview displaying financial metrics (payouts, profit, expenses, tax), payout history, and advance tax reminders with trend indicators.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/DiscountOff: Page for displaying exclusive prop firm promotional offers, currently showing an empty state.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Exchange.ts: Currency exchange page with tabs for FX and crypto converters, using mock exchange rates to calculate conversions between currencies.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Expenses.ts: Expense tracking page showing business and personal expense totals with an empty state for recent expenses.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Giveaways.t: Giveaways page with a coming soon placeholder for future prop firm account giveaways and community rewards.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/IncomeTaxCa: Placeholder page for income tax calculator feature with a card displaying 'Tax calculator coming soon' message.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/P2PExchange: Placeholder page for P2P crypto exchange feature with a 'Coming Soon' message and icon.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Payouts.tsx: Payouts tracking page with 'Add Payout' button and empty state showing 'No payouts recorded yet'.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/ReviewsDisp: Tabbed interface for managing reviews and disputes with buttons to write reviews or raise disputes, both showing empty states.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Settings.ts: Placeholder settings page displaying 'Profile settings coming soon' message.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/TaxAuditRep: Tax audit report page with 'Export PDF' button and placeholder message to configure tax settings.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/Tools.tsx: Trading tools page with five calculator tabs (Risk, Margin, P/L, Lot Size, Swap) providing various trading calculation utilities with input forms and result displays.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/TradingOver: Trading analytics dashboard showing metric cards (Total Trades, Win Rate, Profit Factor, Sharpe Ratio) and equity curve chart, currently in empty state.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/TradingTool: Trading tools shop page with empty state showing 'No products available yet' message.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page component showcasing Propfolio's features with hero section, feature cards, testimonials, and pricing information. Includes navigation to signup/login and displays 12 key features like dashboard, payouts, tax reports, and trading tools.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Payment failure page displaying an error message with options to retry payment or return home. Shows a red X icon and provides navigation buttons.

frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicy.tsx: Privacy policy page displaying information collection, usage, sharing, security, and user rights policies. Includes back navigation and footer.

frontend/src/pages/Subscribe.tsx: Subscription page displaying the $75/year Professional Trader Suite plan with 12 features listed. Includes subscribe button and navigation back to home.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom theme extensions including color palette, animations, shadows, and typography plugin setup.
project_state.json: Project state document defining Propfolio as a prop trading management platform with architectural notes, known limitations, and existing features including authentication, navigation, and prop firm management.
